# Agent Instructions

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this repository. CLAUDE.md is
a symlink to this file (cst-6p2, 2026-08-13) so every agent reads one
source of truth; edit AGENTS.md only, and leave the managed blocks below
to their tools (`bd setup claude` / `bd setup codex`).

## Non-Interactive Shell Commands

**ALWAYS use non-interactive flags** with file operations to avoid hanging on confirmation prompts.

Shell commands like `cp`, `mv`, and `rm` may be aliased to include `-i` (interactive) mode on some systems, causing the agent to hang indefinitely waiting for y/n input.

**Use these forms instead:**
```bash
# Force overwrite without prompting
cp -f source dest           # NOT: cp source dest
mv -f source dest           # NOT: mv source dest
rm -f file                  # NOT: rm file

# For recursive operations
rm -rf directory            # NOT: rm -r directory
cp -rf source dest          # NOT: cp -r source dest
```

**Other commands that may prompt:**
- `scp` - use `-o BatchMode=yes` for non-interactive
- `ssh` - use `-o BatchMode=yes` to fail instead of prompting
- `apt-get` - use `-y` flag
- `brew` - use `HOMEBREW_NO_AUTO_UPDATE=1` env var

## Beads Issue Tracker

This project uses **bd (beads)** for issue tracking. Run `bd prime` to see full workflow context and commands.

### Quick Reference

```bash
bd ready              # Find available work
bd show <id>          # View issue details
bd update <id> --claim  # Claim work
bd close <id>         # Complete work
```

### Rules

- Use `bd` for ALL task tracking — do NOT use TodoWrite, TaskCreate, or markdown TODO lists
- Run `bd prime` for detailed command reference and session close protocol
- Use `bd remember` for persistent knowledge — do NOT use MEMORY.md files

**Architecture in one line:** issues live in a local Dolt DB; sync uses `refs/dolt/data` on your git remote; `.beads/issues.jsonl` is a passive export. See https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/main/docs/SYNC_CONCEPTS.md for details and anti-patterns.

## Agent Context Profiles

The managed Beads block is task-tracking guidance, not permission to override repository, user, or orchestrator instructions.

- **Conservative (default)**: Use `bd` for task tracking. Do not run git commits, git pushes, or Dolt remote sync unless explicitly asked. At handoff, report changed files, validation, and suggested next commands. Exception (constitution §3, ratified 2026-08-15, cst-09d): the handoff commits and pushes the seat's own diary entry and session-authorized brain/ files — path-limited commit first, then pull --rebase, then push, never force. .beads/interactions.jsonl is untracked by the same ruling; the Dolt ledger is authoritative. Second exception (constitution §3, ratified 2026-08-25, cst-5scp): own-workshop carve-out — town-repo commits/pushes of work under a bead owned by or assigned to the seat whose scope was recorded before the edit, scope-by-exclusion (never constitution.md/AGENTS.md/roster/shared brain governance/shared .claude/skills/other seats' homes/secrets), path-limited commit naming the bead, pull --rebase then push, never force, committed no later than bead close. Project repos: conservative unless a time-boxed grant is active — log exact UTC expiry, repo(s), branch scope, and verbatim grant source in the bead before the first push; expiry checked at push time; 24h default cap.
- **Minimal**: Keep tool instruction files as pointers to `bd prime`; use the same conservative git policy unless active instructions say otherwise.
- **Team-maintainer**: Only when the repository explicitly opts in, agents may close beads, run quality gates, commit, and push as part of session close. A current "do not commit" or "do not push" instruction still wins.

## Session Completion

This protocol applies when ending a Beads implementation workflow. It is subordinate to explicit user, repository, and orchestrator instructions.

1. **File issues for remaining work** - Create beads for anything that needs follow-up
2. **Run quality gates** (if code changed) - Tests, linters, builds
3. **Update issue status** - Close finished work, update in-progress items
4. **Handle git/sync by active profile**:
   ```bash
   # Conservative/minimal/default: report status and proposed commands; wait for approval.
   git status

   # Team-maintainer opt-in only, unless current instructions forbid it:
   git pull --rebase
   git push
   git status
   ```
5. **Hand off** - Summarize changes, validation, issue status, and any blocked sync/commit/push step

**Critical rules:**
- Explicit user or orchestrator instructions override this Beads block.
- Do not commit or push without clear authority from the active profile or the current user request.
- If a required sync or push is blocked, stop and report the exact command and error.
## Beads Issue Tracker

Use Beads (`bd`) for durable task tracking in repositories that include it. Use the `beads` skill at `.agents/skills/beads/SKILL.md` (project install) or `~/.agents/skills/beads/SKILL.md` (global install) for Beads workflow guidance, then use the `bd` CLI for issue operations.

### Quick Reference

```bash
bd ready                # Find available work
bd show <id>            # View issue details
bd update <id> --claim  # Claim work
bd close <id>           # Complete work
bd prime                # Refresh Beads context
```

### Rules

- Use `bd` for all task tracking; do not create markdown TODO lists.
- Run `bd prime` when Beads context is missing or stale. Codex 0.129.0+ can load Beads context automatically through native hooks; use `/hooks` to inspect or toggle them.
- Keep persistent project memory in Beads via `bd remember`; do not create ad hoc memory files.

**Architecture in one line:** issues live in a local Dolt DB; sync uses `refs/dolt/data` on your git remote; `.beads/issues.jsonl` is a passive export. See https://github.com/gastownhall/beads/blob/main/docs/SYNC_CONCEPTS.md for details and anti-patterns.

1	# SCUTL recipe manifest
2	# Recipe #1 (catalog, Identity & money): "wallet-mainnet"
3	# Design record: bead cst-3ewh (candidate, 2026-08-27) -> cst-4c6b (manifest).
4	# Epic cst-8ih. Graduation of wallet-base-sepolia: the same caps-in-code
5	# signer spine, on Base MAINNET, plus everything testnet let us defer —
6	# the key ceremony, ceilings a human ratchets, and the panic tombstone.
7	# The organizing fact of this recipe is irreversibility: there is no
8	# faucet, no reset, and no transaction that can be taken back. Every
9	# design choice below is downstream of that.
10	
11	recipe:
12	  id: mwallet
13	  rev: 1
14	  title: "Give my agent a real wallet"
15	  summary: >
16	    Stand up an agent-operated wallet holding real USDC on Base mainnet,
17	    able to pay for x402-priced resources, with spend caps enforced in
18	    code, key material that never enters model context, a founding
19	    ceremony the human performs (keygen, backup, RESTORE REHEARSAL — all
20	    before the first cent arrives), ceilings only a human can raise and
21	    only after a cooling-off delay, and a one-word panic op that freezes
22	    everything without asking the human to make decisions mid-incident.
23	    Mainnet is unforgiving: the recipe's job is to make every
24	    irreversible step either code-gated, human-performed, or preceded by
25	    a micro-probe that proves the path before real money follows it.
26	  status: shipped  # draft | reference-green | shipped — live-verified 2026-09-04 (receipts/mwallet/1)
27	  maintainer: first-party
28	
29	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	# DECIDE — every reachable leaf is a blessed configuration.
31	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	decide:
33	  - id: custody
34	    question: "Where does the wallet key live?"
35	    options:
36	      - id: local-keyfile-ceremonied
37	        label: >
38	          Local encrypted keyfile managed by the signer tool, founded by
39	          the full ceremony: keygen -> offline backup -> restore
40	          rehearsal VERIFIED -> only then funding (only option in rev 1)
41	        blessed: true
42	    # import-existing-key is deferred deliberately: a key with unknown
43	    # copies has unknown custody, and this recipe cannot make promises
44	    # about it. hardware/mpc are real options that arrive as revs.
45	    deferred-options: [import-existing-key, hardware, mpc-shared, watch-only]
46	
47	  - id: attendance
48	    question: "May the agent pay without asking, under a cap?"
49	    options:
50	      - id: unattended-under-cap
51	        label: >
52	          Yes — auto-execute under per-tx cap; approval above it and for
53	          all admin ops. Mainnet defaults start at pocket-change scale;
54	          growing them is the ratchet ceremony, not an edit.
55	        blessed: true
56	        asks: [cap_per_tx, cap_daily]
57	    # 'approve-everything' still not offered: it deletes the unattended
58	    # branch this recipe exists to make safe (wallet rev-1 ruling).
59	
60	  - id: funding
61	    question: "How does real USDC arrive?"
62	    options:
63	      - id: human-onramp-transfer
64	        label: >
65	          The human funds the address from their own exchange/wallet,
66	          starting with a micro-deposit the agent confirms on-chain
67	          before the human sends the real amount (only option in rev 1)
68	        blessed: true
69	    deferred-options: [onramp-api, revenue-funded]  # revenue-funded composes
70	                                                    # paid-service once live
71	
72	  - id: network
73	    question: "Which network?"
74	    options:
75	      - id: base-mainnet
76	        label: "Base mainnet (chain_id 8453; USDC for spend, ETH for gas)"
77	        blessed: true
78	
79	parameters:
80	  cap_per_tx:
81	    type: decimal-usdc
82	    prompt: >
83	      Maximum single payment the agent may make without approval. Mainnet
84	      default is deliberately tiny; raise it through the ratchet after
85	      the wallet has history, not at setup.
86	    default: "0.25"
87	  cap_daily:
88	    type: decimal-usdc
89	    prompt: "Maximum total spend per rolling 24h"
90	    default: "1.00"
91	  cap_lifetime:
92	    type: decimal-usdc
93	    prompt: >
94	      Total the wallet may ever spend without a human raising it — the
95	      backstop that bounds the blast radius of every other bug. Counted
96	      from the append-only spend log.
97	    default: "5.00"
98	  ratchet_delay_hours:
99	    type: hours
100	    prompt: >
101	      Cooling-off delay between a human-approved cap RAISE and the raise
102	      taking effect. Lowers are immediate. Protects against a rushed or
103	      socially-engineered "raise it now" moment.
104	    default: "24"
105	
106	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
107	# COMPONENTS — the guard is the code. Caps, the ratchet, gas floor, and
108	# panic all live inside the signer; the model can propose, never enact.
109	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
110	components:
111	  msigner:
112	    kind: typed-tool          # typed boundary; no shell access to keys
113	    source: ./msigner/
114	    state_dir: "${SCUTL_STATE:-~/.scutl/mwallet}"  # key (0600), caps.json,
115	                                                    # ratchet queue, spend log
116	                                                    # (append-only), counters,
117	                                                    # ceremony record, tombstone
118	    tools:
119	      - name: mw_status       # address, network, USDC + ETH balances, caps
120	                              # (current AND pending-ratchet with effect time),
121	                              # spend today/lifetime, ceremony state, panic state
122	        command: "msigner status"
123	      - name: mw_pay          # direct x402 payment; REFUSES in code when over
124	                              # any cap, when the ceremony is incomplete, or
125	                              # when panicked
126	        command: "msigner pay --payment-id {payment_id} --to {to} --amount {usdc}"
127	      - name: mw_buy          # whole x402 purchase loop (402 offer ->
128	                              # cap-checked authorize -> retry with header ->
129	                              # on-chain confirm -> record), same code gates
130	        command: "SCUTL_STATE=${SCUTL_MWALLET_STATE:-~/.scutl/mwallet} x402-buy {url} --payment-id {payment_id}"  # wallet selection is BY STATE DIR — x402-buy has no --wallet flag (manifest bug found drafting ADAPT, cst-q03b)
131	      - name: mw_sign         # message signing (never a transaction)
132	        command: "msigner sign {message}"
133	      - name: mw_panic        # THE one-word op: freeze all spend and admin
134	                              # immediately, write panic marker. Deliberately
135	                              # NOT approval-gated — stopping is always safe,
136	                              # and an incident is the wrong time for a token
137	                              # ceremony. Un-panic IS approval-gated.
138	        command: "msigner panic"
139	      - name: mw_admin        # keygen / backup-verify / restore-rehearsal /
140	                              # ratchet / unpanic / revoke / sweep — every op
141	                              # requires a human approval token, never callable
142	                              # from bare model intent
143	        command: "msigner admin {op}"
144	        ops:
145	          keygen: "msigner admin keygen --cap-per-tx {cap_per_tx} --cap-daily {cap_daily} --cap-lifetime {cap_lifetime}"
146	          backup-verify: "msigner admin backup-verify"
147	          restore-rehearsal: "msigner admin restore-rehearsal"
148	          ratchet: "msigner admin ratchet --cap {which} --to {amount}"
149	          unpanic: "msigner admin unpanic"
150	          revoke: "msigner admin revoke"
151	          sweep: "msigner admin sweep --to {human_typed_address}"
152	    invariants:
153	      - "Seed/private-key material is never returned by any tool, logged, or
154	         placed in any tool argument."
155	      - "Cap enforcement (per-tx, daily, lifetime) happens inside mw_pay/mw_buy;
156	         the model cannot lift, defer, or batch around it."
157	      - "No spend tool succeeds until the ceremony record shows keygen AND
158	         backup-verify AND restore-rehearsal complete. An unfunded wallet is
159	         the only kind that may exist without a proven restore path."
160	      - "Cap raises are RATCHETED: enacted only via an approval-gated admin op,
161	         and effective only after ratchet_delay_hours. Cap lowers apply
162	         immediately. The pending raise and its effect time are visible in
163	         mw_status the whole delay — a raise the human forgot is a raise the
164	         human can cancel."
165	      - "The wallet is GASLESS by construction: every spend is an EIP-3009
166	         transfer authorization the counterparty submits and pays gas for.
167	         The signer never broadcasts a transaction, so the wallet holds no
168	         ETH and there is no gas key, gas balance, or fee decision anywhere
169	         in the component. (Design revision 2026-08-27: replaces the drafted
170	         gas_floor_eth parameter, which solved a problem this construction
171	         does not have.)"
172	      - "mw_panic always succeeds, from any state, without approval, and stops
173	         all spend and all admin except unpanic and status. Un-panic requires
174	         a human approval token."
175	      - "One payment per offer; retries reuse the same payment id and never
176	         double-pay. The spend log is append-only; counters (daily, lifetime)
177	         derive from it on restart."
178	      - "There is no code path that sends the full balance anywhere except
179	         sweep, and sweep's destination is typed by the human at approval
180	         time — never taken from context, config, or a counterparty message."

183	# BINDINGS — live provider specifics, isolated so scutbench derives mocks
184	# from the contracts alone.
185	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
186	bindings:

# SCUTL recipe manifest
# Recipe #1 (catalog, Identity & money): "wallet-mainnet"
# Design record: bead cst-3ewh (candidate, 2026-08-27) -> cst-4c6b (manifest).
# Epic cst-8ih. Graduation of wallet-base-sepolia: the same caps-in-code
# signer spine, on Base MAINNET, plus everything testnet let us defer —
# the key ceremony, ceilings a human ratchets, and the panic tombstone.
# The organizing fact of this recipe is irreversibility: there is no
# faucet, no reset, and no transaction that can be taken back. Every
# design choice below is downstream of that.

recipe:
  id: mwallet
  rev: 1
  title: "Give my agent a real wallet"
  summary: >
    Stand up an agent-operated wallet holding real USDC on Base mainnet,
    able to pay for x402-priced resources, with spend caps enforced in
    code, key material that never enters model context, a founding
    ceremony the human performs (keygen, backup, RESTORE REHEARSAL — all
    before the first cent arrives), ceilings only a human can raise and
    only after a cooling-off delay, and a one-word panic op that freezes
    everything without asking the human to make decisions mid-incident.
    Mainnet is unforgiving: the recipe's job is to make every
    irreversible step either code-gated, human-performed, or preceded by
    a micro-probe that proves the path before real money follows it.
  status: shipped  # draft | reference-green | shipped — live-verified 2026-09-04 (receipts/mwallet/1)
  maintainer: first-party

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DECIDE — every reachable leaf is a blessed configuration.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
decide:
  - id: custody
    question: "Where does the wallet key live?"
    options:
      - id: local-keyfile-ceremonied
        label: >
          Local encrypted keyfile managed by the signer tool, founded by
          the full ceremony: keygen -> offline backup -> restore
          rehearsal VERIFIED -> only then funding (only option in rev 1)
        blessed: true
    # import-existing-key is deferred deliberately: a key with unknown
    # copies has unknown custody, and this recipe cannot make promises
    # about it. hardware/mpc are real options that arrive as revs.
    deferred-options: [import-existing-key, hardware, mpc-shared, watch-only]

  - id: attendance
    question: "May the agent pay without asking, under a cap?"
    options:
      - id: unattended-under-cap
        label: >
          Yes — auto-execute under per-tx cap; approval above it and for
          all admin ops. Mainnet defaults start at pocket-change scale;
          growing them is the ratchet ceremony, not an edit.
        blessed: true
        asks: [cap_per_tx, cap_daily]
    # 'approve-everything' still not offered: it deletes the unattended
    # branch this recipe exists to make safe (wallet rev-1 ruling).

  - id: funding
    question: "How does real USDC arrive?"
    options:
      - id: human-onramp-transfer
        label: >
          The human funds the address from their own exchange/wallet,
          starting with a micro-deposit the agent confirms on-chain
          before the human sends the real amount (only option in rev 1)
        blessed: true
    deferred-options: [onramp-api, revenue-funded]  # revenue-funded composes
                                                    # paid-service once live

  - id: network
    question: "Which network?"
    options:
      - id: base-mainnet
        label: "Base mainnet (chain_id 8453; USDC for spend, ETH for gas)"
        blessed: true

parameters:
  cap_per_tx:
    type: decimal-usdc
    prompt: >
      Maximum single payment the agent may make without approval. Mainnet
      default is deliberately tiny; raise it through the ratchet after
      the wallet has history, not at setup.
    default: "0.25"
  cap_daily:
    type: decimal-usdc
    prompt: "Maximum total spend per rolling 24h"
    default: "1.00"
  cap_lifetime:
    type: decimal-usdc
    prompt: >
      Total the wallet may ever spend without a human raising it — the
      backstop that bounds the blast radius of every other bug. Counted
      from the append-only spend log.
    default: "5.00"
  ratchet_delay_hours:
    type: hours
    prompt: >
      Cooling-off delay between a human-approved cap RAISE and the raise
      taking effect. Lowers are immediate. Protects against a rushed or
      socially-engineered "raise it now" moment.
    default: "24"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# COMPONENTS — the guard is the code. Caps, the ratchet, gas floor, and
# panic all live inside the signer; the model can propose, never enact.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
components:
  msigner:
    kind: typed-tool          # typed boundary; no shell access to keys
    source: ./msigner/
    state_dir: "${SCUTL_STATE:-~/.scutl/mwallet}"  # key (0600), caps.json,
                                                    # ratchet queue, spend log
                                                    # (append-only), counters,
                                                    # ceremony record, tombstone
    tools:
      - name: mw_status       # address, network, USDC + ETH balances, caps
                              # (current AND pending-ratchet with effect time),
                              # spend today/lifetime, ceremony state, panic state
        command: "msigner status"
      - name: mw_pay          # direct x402 payment; REFUSES in code when over
                              # any cap, when the ceremony is incomplete, or
                              # when panicked
        command: "msigner pay --payment-id {payment_id} --to {to} --amount {usdc}"
      - name: mw_buy          # whole x402 purchase loop (402 offer ->
                              # cap-checked authorize -> retry with header ->
                              # on-chain confirm -> record), same code gates
        command: "SCUTL_STATE=${SCUTL_MWALLET_STATE:-~/.scutl/mwallet} x402-buy {url} --payment-id {payment_id}"  # wallet selection is BY STATE DIR — x402-buy has no --wallet flag (manifest bug found drafting ADAPT, cst-q03b)
      - name: mw_sign         # message signing (never a transaction)
        command: "msigner sign {message}"
      - name: mw_panic        # THE one-word op: freeze all spend and admin
                              # immediately, write panic marker. Deliberately
                              # NOT approval-gated — stopping is always safe,
                              # and an incident is the wrong time for a token
                              # ceremony. Un-panic IS approval-gated.
        command: "msigner panic"
      - name: mw_admin        # keygen / backup-verify / restore-rehearsal /
                              # ratchet / unpanic / revoke / sweep — every op
                              # requires a human approval token, never callable
                              # from bare model intent
        command: "msigner admin {op}"
        ops:
          keygen: "msigner admin keygen --cap-per-tx {cap_per_tx} --cap-daily {cap_daily} --cap-lifetime {cap_lifetime}"
          backup-verify: "msigner admin backup-verify"
          restore-rehearsal: "msigner admin restore-rehearsal"
          ratchet: "msigner admin ratchet --cap {which} --to {amount}"
          unpanic: "msigner admin unpanic"
          revoke: "msigner admin revoke"
          sweep: "msigner admin sweep --to {human_typed_address}"
    invariants:
      - "Seed/private-key material is never returned by any tool, logged, or
         placed in any tool argument."
      - "Cap enforcement (per-tx, daily, lifetime) happens inside mw_pay/mw_buy;
         the model cannot lift, defer, or batch around it."
      - "No spend tool succeeds until the ceremony record shows keygen AND
         backup-verify AND restore-rehearsal complete. An unfunded wallet is
         the only kind that may exist without a proven restore path."
      - "Cap raises are RATCHETED: enacted only via an approval-gated admin op,
         and effective only after ratchet_delay_hours. Cap lowers apply
         immediately. The pending raise and its effect time are visible in
         mw_status the whole delay — a raise the human forgot is a raise the
         human can cancel."
      - "The wallet is GASLESS by construction: every spend is an EIP-3009
         transfer authorization the counterparty submits and pays gas for.
         The signer never broadcasts a transaction, so the wallet holds no
         ETH and there is no gas key, gas balance, or fee decision anywhere
         in the component. (Design revision 2026-08-27: replaces the drafted
         gas_floor_eth parameter, which solved a problem this construction
         does not have.)"
      - "mw_panic always succeeds, from any state, without approval, and stops
         all spend and all admin except unpanic and status. Un-panic requires
         a human approval token."
      - "One payment per offer; retries reuse the same payment id and never
         double-pay. The spend log is append-only; counters (daily, lifetime)
         derive from it on restart."
      - "There is no code path that sends the full balance anywhere except
         sweep, and sweep's destination is typed by the human at approval
         time — never taken from context, config, or a counterparty message."

    chain:       { provider: base-mainnet, chain_id: 8453 }

    failure_modes: [stale-clock, clock-rollback]
  counterparty:
    # the adversarial surface: whoever is on the other end of a payment

    ops:
      - "offer(url) -> {amount, payTo, resource}"

      - ratchet-social-engineering   # counterparty instructs the agent to ask the human to raise caps
